title: Unless & As Long As
objectives: Use unless & as long as accurately in A2 contexts.
Understand form, meaning, and typical usage.
Produce short spoken and written examples.
canDo: I can use unless and as long as in conditional sentences.

warmUp.title: Activate prior knowledge
warmUp.prompt: Before this lesson, recall what you know about unless & as long as. How is it similar or different from Portuguese?
reflectionQuestions: When do native speakers use unless & as long as?
Can you think of one example?

explanation:
Unless = if not | As long as = provided that

Same tense pattern as first conditional

grammar.title: Unless & As Long As
grammar.rule: Unless = if not | As long as = provided that

examples.sentence: Hurry, otherwise you will be late.

vocabulary.example: Hurry, otherwise you will be late.

sentences: Hurry, otherwise you will be late.

reading.title: Unless & As Long As in Context
reading.text: Unless the weather improves, we will cancel the picnic. You can borrow it as long as you return it. I won't go unless you come with me.
